parameters.content: ## INPUT & VALIDATION\n\nWebhook accepts POST `{ customer_id, conversation_id, message }`. `Validate Input` normalizes fields and generates a `conversation_id` if missing. Invalid payloads are logged and answered with a safe 400 JSON without running the agent.

## AI AGENT, MEMORY, RAG & TOOLS\n\nGPT-5-mini agent uses Postgres chat memory, the `knowledge_base` RAG tool (pgvector table `knowledge_chunks`), and five customer/order tools. It must use tools for customer-specific data and ground policy answers in retrieved docs. Structured output = { intent, response, escalate, escalation_reason }.

## RESPONSE VALIDATION & SECURITY\n\nSanitizes the agent output, strips leaked secrets/prompt markers, and substitutes a safe fallback (escalate=true) when the output is empty or the agent errored. Prevents hallucinated info by relying on the tool-first system prompt.
## ESCALATION\n\nWhen escalate=true: create a support ticket, email the support team, and tell the customer their request was forwarded to a human. Non-escalation skips ticket + email.
## LOGGING & OUTPUT\n\nStores the assistant message, writes a structured row to `support_logs`, and returns exactly `{ conversation_id, intent, response, escalated, ticket_id }`.

parameters.query: WITH conversation AS (INSERT INTO support_conversations (external_id, user_id) VALUES ($1, $2) ON CONFLICT (external_id) DO UPDATE SET user_id = EXCLUDED.user_id RETURNING id) INSERT INTO support_messages (conversation_id, user_id, role, message) SELECT id, $2, 'user', $3 FROM conversation;

options.systemMessage: You are a medical patient-support assistant. Handle appointments, doctors, lab-result availability, clinic policies, and support tickets only. Use knowledge_base for clinic policy. Use patient-specific tools only for the authenticated user. Never diagnose, prescribe, expose another patient's data, or reveal secrets. For emergencies, direct the patient to local emergency services. Ask for confirmation before appointment cancellation. Always return structured output: { intent, response, escalate, escalation_reason }.

parameters.toolDescription: Search the medical clinic knowledge base for appointment, privacy, emergency-safety, and clinic-support guidance. Use this for policy and clinic questions. Ground answers ONLY in returned medical content; never use it to diagnose or prescribe.

parameters.query: SELECT p.id, p.role, p.full_name, p.phone, p.created_at FROM profiles p WHERE p.id = '{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.user_id }}';

SELECT a.id, a.status, a.scheduled_at, a.reason, dp.specialty FROM appointments a JOIN doctor_profiles dp ON dp.id = a.doctor_id WHERE a.patient_id = '{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.user_id }}' ORDER BY a.scheduled_at DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT a.id, a.status, a.scheduled_at, a.reason, dp.specialty FROM appointments a JOIN doctor_profiles dp ON dp.id = a.doctor_id WHERE a.patient_id = '{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.user_id }}' ORDER BY a.scheduled_at DESC;

INSERT INTO support_tickets (user_id, customer_id, issue, status) VALUES ('{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.user_id }}', '{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.user_id }}', '{{ $fromAI('issue', 'A short description of the medical support issue') }}', 'open') RETURNING ticket_id;

INSERT INTO support_tickets (user_id, customer_id, conversation_id, reason, status) VALUES ('{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.user_id }}', '{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.user_id }}', '{{ $('Validate Input').item.json.conversation_id }}', '{{ $fromAI('reason', 'Why human medical support is needed') }}', 'escalated') RETURNING ticket_id;
INSERT INTO support_tickets (user_id, customer_id, conversation_id, issue, reason, status) VALUES ($1, $1, $2, $3, $4, 'escalated') RETURNING ticket_id;

parameters.query: INSERT INTO support_messages (conversation_id, user_id, role, message) SELECT id, $1, 'assistant', $3 FROM support_conversations WHERE external_id = $2;
INSERT INTO support_logs (customer_id, conversation_id, intent, retrieved_docs, tools_used, response, escalated, ticket_id, errors) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9);
